titus.2.p1.b1.text: But as for you, speak the things that are consistent with sound doctrine.

titus.2.p1.b2.text: Older men are to be temperate, dignified, self-controlled, …

titus.2.p1.b3.text: Older women, likewise, are to be reverent in their behavior, … but teachers of good.

titus.2.p1.b4.text: In this way they can train the young women to love their husbands and children, … so that the word of God will not be discredited.

titus.2.p2.b1.text: In the same way, urge the younger men to be self-controlled.

titus.2.p2.b2.text: In everything, show yourself to be an example by doing good works. In your teaching show integrity, dignity,

titus.2.p2.b3.text: and wholesome speech that is above reproach, so that anyone who opposes us will be ashamed to have nothing bad to say about us.

titus.2.p3.b1.text: Slaves are to submit to their own masters in everything, to be well-pleasing, not argumentative,

titus.2.p3.b2.text: not stealing from them, but showing all good faith,

titus.2.p3.b3.text: so that in every respect they will adorn the teaching about God our Savior.

titus.2.p4.b1.text: For the grace of God has appeared, bringing salvation to everyone.

titus.2.p4.b2.text: It instructs us … to live sensible, upright, and godly lives in the present age, as we await the blessed hope …

titus.2.p4.b3.text: He gave Himself for us … to purify for Himself a people for His own possession, zealous for good deeds.

titus.2.p4.b4.text: Speak these things as you encourage and rebuke with all authority.
